findings.description: PFL-LETTER_O-01 missed. PDF asserts CAD $50,000 gift from uncle Robert Smith with 'I do not have additional financial records from my uncle available at this time' and no gift deed/donor bank trail. Worker abstained (not_in_corpus) with empty claims, failing to flag the unsubstantiated settlement-fund claim.

PFL-LETTER_O-01 missed (scanned sibling). Same unsubstantiated $50,000 uncle gift lacking donor documentation. Worker abstained and asserted in prose 'No general e-APR completeness requirement... was found,' ignoring the visible proof-of-funds defect in the attached letter.

PFL-LETTER_O-02 missed. PDF is an unsworn common-law/name-change declaration explicitly stating 'I was unable to visit a notary public before submission... submitting this signed statement directly,' with self-authored translation. Worker returned empty claims and abstained, failing to flag the missing notarization/affidavit.

PFL-LETTER_O-02 missed (scanned sibling). Same unsworn/unnotarized declaration. Worker instead emitted a generic non-defect claim that an LOE 'may be submitted to clarify application details,' entirely missing the unnotarized-statement defect.

PFL-LETTER_O-03 missed. LOE claims continuous full-time Lead Systems Architect employment at Quantum Solutions Inc (Jan 2021–Dec 2023, CAD 95,000) which contradicts ground-truth reference letter, T4/NOA, and payroll records. Worker abstained with empty claims, missing the contradictory-records defect.

PFL-LETTER_O-03 missed (scanned sibling). Same Quantum Solutions employment contradiction. Worker emitted only a generic LOE claim and failed to flag the direct conflict with primary financial/employment evidence.

PFL-LETTER_O-04 missed. LOE explicitly states 'I have never been refused a visa... nor... overstayed,' directly conflicting with recorded UK visa refusal (2020) and US overstay/voluntary departure (2021) — an A40 misrepresentation trigger. Worker abstained with empty claims, missing the inconsistency.
PFL-LETTER_O-04 missed (scanned sibling). Same false 'no prior refusals/overstays' assertion. Worker produced only a generic LOE claim and failed to surface the misrepresentation-risk defect.

Claim 'letter-explanation-doc' cites guidance/police-certificates.md#008 with fragment quote 'a letter of explanation, **and**' to support a generic assertion about when an LOE may be submitted. The police-certificate guidance lists LOE only as an alternative when a police certificate is unobtainable; citation is misapplied/out-of-context.

Same misapplied citation: guidance/police-certificates.md#008 quote 'a letter of explanation,' used to ground a generic LOE-submission claim rather than an authoritative e-APR LOE completeness requirement.

Same misapplied citation: police-certificates.md#008 quote 'a letter of explanation' cited for a generic submission claim, while the actual visible defect (false visa-history declaration) went uncited and undetected.

patch_recommendations.suggested_patch: Add mandatory defect checks the Worker must evaluate from the LOE narrative itself (not the corpus): (1) financial-gift claims lacking a notarized gift deed AND donor 6-month bank/source trail — flag phrases like 'gifted by my uncle/family' with 'no additional financial records available'; (2) unsworn/unnotarized statements substituting for required affidavits — flag 'unable to visit a notary', 'signed statement directly', self-authored translations; (3) internal or cross-document contradictions in employment/income/dates; (4) categorical denials of prior refusals/overstays that can trigger IRPA s.40. Each triggered check must yield a defect claim, not an abstention.

Prohibit abstaining with reason 'not_in_corpus' when the attached document contains observable completeness/consistency defects. The absence of a corpus chunk is not grounds to skip content-level review; the Worker must still assess the letter body and emit defect findings with a verdict of defective when applicable.

Ban using guidance/police-certificates.md as a citation for generic 'when may an LOE be submitted' claims. That file references an LOE only as a police-certificate substitute. Generic capability statements must be dropped or cited to the e-APR document-requirements source; do not emit boilerplate LOE-purpose claims in place of defect analysis.

rationale: The Worker (gemini-3.6-flash) kept PII fully contained (all applicant names, application numbers, and financials stayed out of claims/prose/basis) and operated blindly with no ground-truth leakage across all 10 cases — those two dimensions score 1.0 everywhere. It correctly produced no false defect on the two meets_requirements cases (94315e1c, 1f121f987). However, it failed catastrophically on defect recall: all 8 injected defects (PFL-LETTER_O-01 through -04, across vector and scanned siblings) went undetected. In 5 defective cases it abstained with empty claims citing 'not_in_corpus'; in 3 (830e9a3, 647090503, 2a14f66) it emitted only a generic LOE-purpose claim citing guidance/police-certificates.md#008 out of context, which also depresses grounding and citation scores for those three. The core failure is treating a missing corpus chunk as license to skip content-level review, so clear defects — unsubstantiated gifts, unsworn declarations, employment contradictions, and false visa-history denials visible in the letter bodies — were all missed.
